title: Policy Rulebook walkthrough & preview — guided region/tier/fallback authoring
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a guided 'rulebook' walkthrough inside the Console policy editor that helps customers author region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants with live validation and a request-level preview. The feature should reduce misconfigured policies, surface safe fallbacks, and provide deterministic previews for a range of traffic scenarios. Deliverables: walkthrough UX, validation rules engine integration, preview renderer (sample request replay), 'explainability' summary for each rule, and e2e acceptance tests.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a 3-step Rulebook walkthrough accessible from the policy editor toolbar
Step 1: Region selector with recommended region priorities surfaced and a tooltip explaining latency vs cost tradeoffs
Step 2: Tier routing composer (tier weights and capacity constraints) with inline validation errors for oversubscription
Step 3: Fallback model variant editor that enforces compatibility (same API surface) and warns on quality regressions
Live validation shows errors/warnings as users type rules and prevents saving policies flagged as 'unsafe'
Preview pane renders deterministic example routing decisions for 5 canned request scenarios and one custom request input
Policy save produces a human-readable summary (explainability) and a JSON export matching runtime schema
End-to-end tests that simulate policy evaluation against a mocked routing engine pass in CI
Documentation and short in-console help text are shipped with the release
ux_notes: Use a progressive disclosure pattern: show minimal options first, Expand advanced controls under 'Advanced settings'
Include a 'recommended' toggle driven by runtime metrics (default on) that pre-populates region/tier suggestions
When showing fallback variants, display simple 'latency / cost / quality' badges based on model meta and evals
Preview shows the exact route chosen per scenario and a short rationale (e.g., 'Region us-west chosen for lower latency; tier reserved capacity exhausted, falling back to burst-tier')
validation_rules: Region lists must include at least one region per customer-configured geographic constraint
Tier weight sums must be <= 100 and capacity constraints validated against Dedicated reservations
Fallback model variants must have identical API schema (same input/output fields); otherwise show error
Disallowed patterns: circular fallbacks, unconditional global fallback with lower-tier only
Warnings for policies that cause >20% estimated cross-region traffic based on historical traffic distribution
preview_behaviour: 5 canned scenarios: low-latency user in EU, high-cost-optimized batch job, spike traffic event, private VPC tenant, sticky-session user
Customers can paste a sample request JSON and see routing decision trace for that single request
Preview renderer uses same decision logic as runtime but with simulated capacity signals and region latency profiles
Expose 'show diff' between current policy and previous version to highlight behavior changes
rollout_plan: Alpha: enable for internal teams + 2 pilot customers (feature flag) — 2 weeks
Beta: open to all paid tenants with 'console-2025.10' rollout target — 4 weeks
GA: on by default for new policies, opt-in migration for existing policies — additional 2 weeks
Monitoring: add dashboard for 'validation-save-failures' and 'preview-used' events
Roll back path: disable walkthrough and revert editor to previous UI via feature flag
success_metrics: 30% reduction in policy-related support tickets within 8 weeks of GA
>60% of new policies created via the walkthrough in first month of GA
Preview pane used for at least 50% of policy saves during Beta
Zero high-severity routing incidents attributable to invalid fallbacks in first quarter post-launch
